note: Weights are Adam-saturated (~+-0.88, sign-like). Nearly every neuron has a dominant frequency k with phase_out ~= phase_a + phase_b (a+b circuit); ~25 are clean Fourier, rest noisy. Edit: for the 39 cheapest neurons (phase err<0.35), flipped entries of fc1 a/b rows and fc2 column whose sign disagreed with the neuron's own best-fit cosine at k (|cos|>0.3), set to clip(1.3cos,+-0.88). 717 entries, no optimizer resets. Trial: held-out 4.8% at +1000 steps vs 2.5% baseline; variant with zeroed noisy biases + resets was slightly worse (4.2%).
